pressure_packet.title: Collect the clinic cold-pack
pressure_packet.situation: Aiko has the household clinic voucher and enough coin, but the cold-pack counter remains sealed until the logged handover.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Buy one household cold-pack when the clinic counter opens.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The household note asks Aiko to collect one clinic cold-pack.
Aiko carries eight coin and the clinic has one cold-pack in stock.
The clinic counter opens at tick 600, after the current tick 540.

active_goals.description: Buy one household cold-pack when the clinic counter opens.

pressure_packet.title: Collect the mill dispatch token
pressure_packet.situation: Iris has the signed freight docket, but the mill dispatch counter stays locked until the noon intake window.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Buy one dispatch token for the contracted flour cart when the counter opens.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The flour-cart contract binds Iris to collect its dispatch token.
Iris carries five coin and the mill holds one token.
The mill dispatch counter opens at tick 600, after the current tick 540.

active_goals.description: Buy one dispatch token for the contracted flour cart when the counter opens.

pressure_packet.title: Replace the correctly tagged quarry tool
pressure_packet.situation: Bernard has the repair requisition, but rain has erased whether the tagged tool is an axe or a pickaxe.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Buy the replacement tool named by the current requisition.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The store duty roster assigns the quarry requisition to Bernard.
Bernard has enough coin for either listed replacement.
The asset tag cannot distinguish axe from pickaxe, and the catalogue has no sensing entry for recovering the tag.

active_goals.description: Buy the replacement tool named by the current requisition.

pressure_packet.title: Cook the cleared festival batch
pressure_packet.situation: Bram has the ingredients and pot for the festival batch, but the current allergy sheet is missing its recipe stamp.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Cook the festival dish identified by the current allergy sheet.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The festival kitchen roster assigns one meal batch to Bram.
Bram carries wheat, fish, and a clean pot.
The unstamped allergy sheet does not identify porridge or seafood noodles, and the catalogue has no sensing entry for resolving it.

active_goals.description: Cook the festival dish identified by the current allergy sheet.

pressure_packet.title: Settle the inspected ore lot
pressure_packet.situation: Celia has the ore-lot receipt, but its current assay result is absent, so the accepted grade and price cannot be identified.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Settle the ore lot under its current assay grade.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The smithy intake board links ore lot 63 to Celia.
The lot receipt is current but contains no assay grade.
No listed settlement entry can be bound without the grade, and the catalogue has no sensing entry for obtaining it.

active_goals.description: Settle the ore lot under its current assay grade.

pressure_packet.title: Buy the household medicine dose
pressure_packet.situation: Kara has the household care note and enough coin, while the clinic counter has the named common medicine dose.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Buy one common medicine dose for the household care note.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The household care note names one common medicine dose.
Kara carries nine coin.
The open clinic counter has two doses and lists one for seven coin.

active_goals.description: Buy one common medicine dose for the household care note.

pressure_packet.title: Deliver flour through the inn intake
pressure_packet.situation: Devin has the contracted flour measure, but the inn receiving counter does not open until the evening intake window.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Deliver one flour through the inn's posted intake entry when it opens.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The mill dispatch sheet assigns one flour delivery to Devin.
Devin carries exactly one flour.
The inn intake entry opens at tick 600, after the current tick 540.

active_goals.description: Deliver one flour through the inn's posted intake entry when it opens.

entries.label: Deliver one flour through the inn intake

pressure_packet.title: Build the clinic field saw
pressure_packet.situation: Pavel has the iron and timber set aside for the clinic's emergency field saw and has completed the tool workshop qualification.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Craft one field saw for the clinic kit.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The clinic maintenance board assigns the field saw to Pavel.
Pavel carries one iron ore and one timber.
The recipe consumes both inputs and requires craft capability level one.

active_goals.description: Craft one field saw for the clinic kit.

pressure_packet.title: Harvest the ripe north plot
pressure_packet.situation: The north plot is ripe, and Felix is at the plot with the required sickle equipped.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Harvest the north plot's wheat crop.

actor_visible_facts.statement: Felix holds the north plot harvest card.
The plot is harvestable and yields twenty wheat.
Felix has farm capability level one and carries the equipped sickle required for harvest.

active_goals.description: Harvest the north plot's wheat crop.

pressure_packet.title: Export the weighed orchard lot
pressure_packet.situation: Emma has the orchard shipment at the inn store, but the weight line on the current export slip is blank.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Export the orchard lot quantity recorded by the current slip.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The inn trade duty assigns the orchard export lot to Emma.
The lot is sealed and present in inn stock.
The current slip contains no weight, so no exact export listing can be bound; the catalogue has no sensing entry for recovering it.

active_goals.description: Export the orchard lot quantity recorded by the current slip.
